record.question: ________ serves the basic health needs of localized communities such as obstetrics, new-born care, immunizations and treatment of minor health problems.
record.explanation: Answer C: Primary Health Centre. A Primary Health Centre is a first-contact facility in India that provides essential primary care services including maternal/newborn care and immunization. Reference: https://www.nhm.gov.in/images/pdf/guidelines/iphs/iphs-revised-guidlines-2022/04-SHC_HWC_UHWC_IPHS_Guidelines-2022.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
